title: Report: Giants were looking for second-round pick for Kayvon Thibodeaux

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Giants were looking for second-round pick for Kayvon Thibodeaux
sources.description: Trade chatter swirled around Kayvon Thibodeaux leading up to and during the draft, but no deal came together and the edge rusher remains with the Giants.
